caseNameFull: E. L. Pierce v. Drainage District No. 17, Mississippi County, Arkansas
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Arkansas.
attorneys: Mr. Arthur T. Brewster, with whom Mr. Jesse C. Sheppard was on the brief, for plaintiffs in error. Mr. G. B. Rose, with whom Mr. D. H. Cantrell, Mr. J. F. Loughborough and Mr. A. W. Dobyns were on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Loop v. Ulysses Land Co., 237 U. S. 580, 583; Piedmont Power & Light Co. v. Graham, 253 U. S. 193, 195.
